issues.message: missing_scope_check: scope-check.json is missing PLAN gate evidence. `scope_check_save` already exists; a lattice-review-scope-plan / scope-plan reviewer must persist the result through `scope_check_save`. The implementation/main agent must not self-sign this evidence or manually edit story metadata. Local CLI guidance is not Authority Server completion and must not be presented as receipt verification or production/full Authority completion.
The review found no blockers, but it is recommended to manually verify checklist completeness against the source-of-truth documents in _reviewPrompt
